description: This file defines a React hook and utility functions for progressively applying work in batches, using requestIdleCallback or setTimeout as fallback, to avoid blocking the main thread. It includes createProgressiveExpandController for batch processing and useProgressiveExpand hook for React component integration.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process items in batches asynchronously, with start and cancel methods, progress callbacks, and adaptive batch sizing.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand
methods.description: A React hook that manages UI state for progressive batch processing, wrapping createProgressiveExpandController, providing start, cancel, progress, and counts.
